title: AI Fed Simulation Predicts Interest Rates Will Hold Steady
summary: he Federal Reserve will decide whether to adjust the US's benchmark interest rate on Wednesday, with investment banks, economists, and journalists waiting to see if their predictions are correct. Researchers Tara Sinclair and Sophia Kazinnik have developed an AI simulation called Sim Fed, which uses AI agents to impersonate the 12 individuals who vote on interest rates, including "Sim Powell" and "Sim Cook". Bloomberg's Stacey Vanek Smith joins to break down what this means for the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Columbia Opens Claims for $16 Million Data Breach Settlement
summary: Columbia University has opened the window for individuals impacted by the school’s data breach last year to claim part of a $16.1 million settlement.

title: Microsoft, Alphabet Earnings Put Focus on AI Cash Flow Drain
summary: Microsoft Corp. and Alphabet Inc. shares have gone separate ways since the companies’ last earnings reports as Wall Street increasingly digs in on the way heavy artificial intelligence spending is weighing on corporate bottom lines. With the two technology giants and major AI players poised to post their results after the bell Wednesday, recent stock market trading indicates that investors give Microsoft an edge. We get a preview from Bloomberg Tech host Ed Ludlow. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Data-Center Borrowing May Test Credit Market: Fortress
summary: Brian Stewart, global co-head of corporate credit at Fortress, says the credit market could face a more serious absorption problem from AI data-center borrowing. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Stewart says that U.S. investment-grade issuance recently reached a record, while the AI funding cycle has so far been driven mainly by venture capital, growth equity and investment-grade bonds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Robinhood Slides, Wendy's Rallies | Stock Movers
summary:
Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Robinhood (HOOD) is declining after the brokerage reported third-quarter earnings per share that missed consensus estimates.

- Etsy (ETSY) shares are gaining after the online retail company reported third-quarter results that beat expectations on key metrics. It also announced that its CFO Lanny Baker will depart to pursue opportunities outside of Etsy. 

- Wendy's (WEN) shares are moving higher on news Nelson Peltz's hedge fund Trian Fund Management is offering to buy the fast food chain for around $1.4 billion. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Causeway CEO Sees Opportunities in AI, Defense Stocks and French Banks
summary: Sarah Ketterer, Causeway Capital Management CEO and fundamental portfolio manager, sees investment opportunities in aerospace and defense stocks. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Ketterer also says "this is the time to accumulate French banks." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: UK Links Data Center Grid Access to Jobs, Local Investment
summary: UK data centers used for critical services will be given priority access to the grid and the authority to generate power on site, under new rules aimed at speeding up construction of essential infrastructure.

title: ASM Lifts 2027 Outlook as AI Buildout Fuels Demand For Tools
summary: ASM International NV increased its revenue target for next year by about 24%, setting up the chip-equipment maker to hit its 2030 goal three years ahead of schedule after a surge in sales linked to AI investments.

title: Drone Stocks Face Deeper Drop as Midterm Blue Wave Risks Grow
summary: Shares of drone makers and suppliers, once the hottest names in the US stock market, are poised to fall further as investors worry a blue wave in the US midterm elections could squeeze funding for the industry.

title: Microsoft and Alphabet Earnings Put Focus on AI Cash Flow Drain
summary: Microsoft Corp. and Alphabet Inc. shares have gone separate ways since the companies’ last earnings reports as Wall Street increasingly digs in on the way heavy artificial intelligence spending is weighing on corporate bottom lines.

title: Anthropic’s Tensions With Trump Laid Bare Ahead of Landmark IPO
summary: Anthropic PBC is cautioning investors that its outspoken advocacy for artificial intelligence safety could make the company the target of government retaliation, highlighting the unusual degree of government-related risk to its future business after a year of skirmishes with the Trump administration.

title: Amazon Unveils New Echo Show 16, Alexa Speakers, Smart Clock and Photo Frame
summary: With its latest devices, including a smart bedside alarm clock, Amazon looks to cement Alexa’s presence in every room of the home

title: Samsung Unveils Galaxy Buds On Clip-On Earbuds for $229
summary: Samsung Electronics Co. unveiled its first pair of cuff-style earbuds, adding to a growing category that includes products from Sony Group Corp., Bose Corp. and several Chinese brands.

title: AI Capex in Mid-Cycle Boom, Says Morgan Stanley’s Shalett
summary: Lisa Shalett, CIO at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, expects the narrative for growth in tech earnings “to continue to stick and hold.” She does, however, see bottlenecks shifting in artificial intelligence capex spending into areas that can cause real questions for investors. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Adds Apple and Microsoft to State Surveillance Registry
summary: Russia added Apple Inc. and Microsoft Corp. to a registry that requires companies to retain users’ communications and provide them to the security services upon request.

title: UAE, Canada Space Firms in Alliance as Nations Seek Starlink Alternatives
summary: Canada’s Terrestar Solutions Inc. agreed to work together with the UAE’s Space42 Plc and US-based Viasat Inc. on a global, open standard to share satellite infrastructure and improve connectivity for mobile devices.

title: Apple iPhone Duo’s Cracked Screen Takes Some Excitement Away From Launch
summary: The first-generation foldable has succumbed to a first-generation sort of defect

title: AI Cybersecurity Startup Upwind Raises at $3.8 Billion Value
summary: Upwind Security, a San Francisco-based startup offering cybersecurity for artificial intelligence and cloud applications, has secured $400 million in fresh financing that values the company at $3.8 billion.

title: Moore Threads Sales Surge Nearly 1,800% on AI Hardware Demand
summary: AI chipmaker Moore Threads Technology Co. said sales grew 1,774% in the three months through September, buoyed by accelerating domestic demand for artificial intelligence hardware.

title: AI Could Boost US Economy GDP Growth by 0.8 Percentage Point in 2026
summary: Economists are forced to make an array of assumptions to understand AI’s effect on the economy
